title: Akbar ke Janaze Pa Ye Farmate Thay Sarwar
body:
Akbar ke janaze pa ye farmate thay Sarwar. kaise uthegi kaise uthegi
Laash jawaan ki kaise uthegi laash jawaan ki kaise uthegi
1. Aankhon may andhera hai sujhayi nahi deta dikhayi nahi deta
Gurbat ko meri dekh ke haste hain sitamgar
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tanhayi hai gurbat hai jawaa laash e pisar hai qaime pa nazar hai
Ye soonchte hain maa na kahin dekhay ye manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Kaandho pa zaaefi may jawaan laash uthaoun kisko mai bulaon
Har gaam pa ye soonch ke rah jaatay hain Sarwar
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ruqq apna sooway nehar kiye kahtay hain Sarwar Abbas e dilawar
Kya sootay ho darya pa utho sheray gazanfer
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Angdaayi lii hatoun pa shabihay nabi jisdum tha karb ka aalam
Gurbat may jaanaze ko lita daala zameen par
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Shabbir ne bachchoun ko sada di mere pyaaro laashe ko sambhalo
Shai yaas se har baar ye kehtay rahe jouher
Azz: Jawad Ali jouher
